snippet.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Voices of the Zone
snippet.description:
Before the stalkers even got to Zalissya in November 2024, a different kind of journey had already been completed — by the people behind the characters you’ve come to know, or are yet to meet. And now, the Zone speaks with their Voices. 
In the video, the cast of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl shares their thoughts, emotions, and memories from working on the game. With every voice line delivered, every motion and emotion captured, they’ve shaped the story you’re now free to explore.
This is a glimpse into the experience of only a few of the almost 200 actors in the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl cast. Into their passion, and the human effort behind the world and narrative of the Zone, recorded at a time when no one knew how the world would respond. And anticipation hung heavy, like the thick air before an Emission starts.
